script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: identity

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: The Unseen Identity

INT. METROPOLITAN BUREAU OF STATISTICS - DAY

JANE LEE, mid-30s, analytics expert, sits at her desk, her eyes glued to a computer screen. She's deeply engrossed in the data she's analyzing, and her mind is a whirlwind of numbers and patterns.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Jane Lee: A master of data, but a mystery to her colleagues.

INT. METROPOLITAN BUREAU OF STATISTICS - CANTEEN - DAY

Jane sits alone at a table, eating a sandwich. Suddenly, her colleague, MIKE, late 40s, enters the canteen. He greets Jane with a smile, but she barely acknowledges him.

MIKE
(Chatting)
Jane, how's it going?

JANE
(Monotone)
Fine.

Mike takes a seat next to Jane and opens his lunch box.

MIKE
(Curious)
You seem a bit off today. Is everything alright?

JANE
(Defensive)
I'm fine. I'm just focused on my work.

MIKE
(Encouraging)
Well, I'm here if you need to talk.

Jane looks up at Mike and smiles weakly.

JANE
(Appreciative)
Thanks, Mike. I'll let you know if I need anything.

INT. METROPOLITAN BUREAU OF STATISTICS - LAB - NIGHT

Jane is still at her desk, surrounded by piles of reports and data. Her boss, SARAH, early 50s, enters the lab.

SARAH
(Concerned)
Jane, I've noticed you've been working long hours. Is everything alright?

JANE
(Guilty)
Yes, everything's fine. I just have a lot on my plate.

Sarah looks at Jane skeptically but decides not to press the issue.

SARAH
Alright, I trust you. But if you need any help, don't hesitate to ask.

INT. METROPOLITAN BUREAU OF STATISTICS - EMPLOYEE LOUNGE - DAY

Jane sits on a couch, staring at her phone. Suddenly, it rings. It's her mom, LUCY.

LUCY (V.O.)
(Anxious)
Jane, where are you? I've been trying to reach you all day.

JANE
(Calm)
I'm at work, Mom.

LUCY
(Worried)
Are you sure you're alright? You sound different.

JANE
(Evasive)
I'm fine, Mom. Just busy.

INT. METROPOLITAN BUREAU OF STATISTICS - LAB - NIGHT

Jane sits in front of her computer, staring blankly at the screen. Suddenly, she receives an email from an anonymous source. It contains a link to an article about her work.

JANE
(Surprised)
Who could have sent me this?

She clicks on the link and reads the article. It's a glowing review of her work, highlighting her exceptional skills and insights. Touched by the recognition, Jane smiles.

INT. METROPOLITAN BUREAU OF STATISTICS - CANTEEN - DAY

Jane sits at the same table as Mike. He looks at her curiously as she smiles to herself.

MIKE
(Curious)
What's got you smiling today, Jane?

JANE
(Grateful)
I just received some recognition for my work.

MIKE
(Surprised)
Really? That's great news!

Jane looks up at Mike and finally opens up to him.

JANE
(Vulnerable)
I've been keeping a secret from all of you. I'm a data analyst, but I also write articles under a pen name. I never told anyone because I was afraid of being judged.

MIKE
(Supportive)
Jane, you have nothing to be afraid of. Your work speaks for itself.

Jane smiles, feeling a weight lifted off her shoulders.

JANE
(Grateful)
Thank you, Mike. I couldn't have done it without your support.

INT. METROPOLITAN BUREAU OF STATISTICS - LAB - NIGHT

Jane sits at her desk, working on her latest article. She feels a sense of fulfillment, knowing that her work is appreciated, both as a data analyst and as a writer.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Jane Lee: A mystery no longer. Her identity, finally unmasked.

FADE OUT.

---

End of screenplay.
